message: No detected input validation: The URL submitted via the form is passed directly to url2list() without any validation of format, scheme, domain allowlist, or content-type checks.

No detected untrusted source handling: scraper.py opens the user-supplied URL with urllib.request.urlopen() without any checksum verification, domain allowlisting, authentication, or integrity check on the fetched content.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on training samples before or during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains a model and predicts but never loads a serialized/pretrained model from disk or any external source with any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision control.

No detected label distribution validation: The learning() function in ML.py directly proceeds to vectorization and training without any check on class balance, label set validity, or anomalous sample detection.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense mechanism anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard scikit-learn SVC with GridSearchCV and no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no adversarial robustness testing anywhere in the code; only standard train/test split and F1 score evaluation are performed.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is used, there is no isolation guarantee (the vectorizer is fit on all X before splitting), no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (F1) is reported without any tamper protection.
No detected input sanitization: User-supplied URL and form fields are used directly without any validation, schema checks, or sanitization before being passed to scraping/ML functions.

No detected output bounds checks: The /estimate route is a stub that immediately redirects without loading a model or checking any output values; no NaN guards or probability bounds exist anywhere in the inference path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical SVM/TF-IDF pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
